meta.name: ponytail-help
meta.description: Quick-reference card for all ponytail modes, skills, and commands. One-shot display, not a persistent mode. Trigger: /ponytail-help, "ponytail help", "what ponytail commands", "how do I use ponytail".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速查阅 ponytail 全部命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在使用 ponytail 但记不住所有命令。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use ponytail and need a command recall.

howto.what: 收到特定触发词后，Claude 会一次性显示一张快速参考卡，列出所有 ponytail 模式、技能和命令。不会改变当前模式或持久化任何内容。
howto.when: 当你说出 “/ponytail-help”、“ponytail help”、“what ponytail commands” 或 “how do I use ponytail” 等触发词时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看 ponytail 有哪些命令。
say.note: Claude 会显示 ponytail 帮助卡。
触发帮助卡，展示 Lite、Full、Ultra 模式。

say.text: 告诉我 ponytail 的所有技能。
say.note: 帮助卡会列出所有技能及其触发方式。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude shows a one-shot reference card listing all ponytail modes, skills, and commands. It does not change mode or persist anything.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/ponytail-help", "ponytail help", "what ponytail commands", or "how do I use ponytail", etc.

say_en.note: Claude displays the ponytail help card.
Triggers help card showing Lite, Full, Ultra modes.
Help card lists all skills and their triggers.
